research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Callsign is researching systems and methods for hardware device fingerprinting, focusing on uniquely identifying a hardware device by obtaining partial keys and encrypted parameters from different sources and decrypting these parameters to establish device identity. This work supports secure customer interactions by enabling reliable device identification, highlighting research and development in device authentication and digital trust.

overview_description.description:
Callsign is pioneering digital trust through proprietary technology that uniquely mimics the way humans identify each other in the real world.  

Positive identification of genuine users delivers privacy, safety and minimal friction whilst ensuring that bad actors are blocked. Through a simple Swipe or Type, users can be personally recognized to a 99.999% accuracy, delivering the highest fidelity AI based user recognition for the digital world. 

To learn more about how this technology is used to underpin digital trust across financial institutions, governments and commerce globally visit: https://www.callsign.com/

product.name: Behavioral Biometrics
product.description: A passive authentication method that identifies users by analyzing unique behavioral patterns such as typing and swiping.

product.name: Muscle Memory Technology
product.description: A high-fidelity behavioral biometrics technology that analyzes detailed user interaction data to accurately identify individuals.

product.name: Orchestration Layer
product.description: A low-code/no-code platform that manages and customizes user authentication journeys and security policies in real-time.

product.name: Threat Detection Technology
product.description: Technology that identifies and blocks threats such as malware, bots, and compromised devices during user sessions.

product.name: Device Recognition
product.description: A technology that profiles devices down to the hardware level to identify returning users without relying on cookies.
